# AumEcho

> Sanskrit mantras, Hindi bhajans, and Vedic chants for meditation, healing, focus, and bhakti — including powerful 108x repetitions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured series, shorts, and curated mantra playlists.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on mantra practice, meditation, and bhakti.
- [Community](/community): Connect with the AumEcho sangha.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about mantras and practice.
- [Founder](/founder): About the founder of AumEcho.
- [Booking](/booking): Book Aum Echo for live concerts and events.
